title.narrative: Towards Inclusive and Just Cooperative Sector in the West Bank III

description.narrative:
The project "Towards Inclusive and Just Cooperative Sector in the West Bank III" will be implemented by the Applied Research Institute - Jerusalem (ARIJ) across selected rural areas of the West Bank, focusing on the governorates where agricultural and food-processing cooperatives operate. ARIJ will work closely with cooperative unions, local authorities, and community-based organizations. The project aims to strengthen the cooperative sector's contribution to sustainable rural development, food security, and economic resilience—particularly for women and youth. It seeks to promote a more inclusive and enabling environment for cooperatives through advocacy, capacity building, and improved access to markets. Expected results include stronger cooperative governance, enhanced coordination among sector stakeholders, increased income and market access for cooperatives, adoption of resilient and green agricultural practices, and greater participation of women and young people in economic activities.
Key activities include advocacy and awareness initiatives, exchange visits, trainings on governance and quality assurance, pilot projects to reduce production costs, development of e-commerce platforms, and promotion of circular-economy and climate-resilient practices. The project contributes to the overarching goal of advancing just, inclusive, and sustainable rural livelihoods in Palestine.
